description.value: Copper River Motel is a roadside motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Terrace, BC, a key stop on a major cycling corridor through northern British Columbia. The property offers a variety of accommodation types including rooms with kitchenettes, trailer units with bunk beds and outdoor fire pits, and RV/camping sites. It is pet friendly and provides high-speed wireless internet.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the motel is open, pet-friendly, and offers high-speed wireless internet, corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. The phone number on the website (250-635-6124) matches OSM (+1-250-635-6124), and the address '4113 Highway 16 East, Terrace BC' matches OSM's '4113 Yellowhead Highway' since Yellowhead Highway and Highway 16 are the same road. No mention of bike storage, laundry, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM address field uses 'Yellowhead Highway' while the website uses 'Highway 16 East' — these refer to the same road but the OSM tag omits the city (Terrace, BC).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel on a major cycling highway in northern BC with an active website and confirmed contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address happy@copperrivermotel.com found on website but not present in OSM tags.
